villager.dialogue.traveller.quest.stay_a: I'm looking for a place to spend the night. I've come a long way on my travels, and I must say I'm rather tired.
Wouldn't you perhaps have a spare bed around here? You would have my many thanks.
Sorry, but we aren't catering to newcomers at the moment.
%s has joined your settlement as a permanent resident.
villager.dialogue.traveller.quest.valida: You don't have a settlement yet. Establish one by building a Trading Post
You settlement has no available homes or beds.
This villager is already part of a settlement.
villager.dialogue.advisor.quest.join.1.p: Excuse me, are you the overseer of this outpost? I've just arrived after a long journey.
The governor's map certainly showed this location to be closer, that's for sure...
I'd love to introduce myself and tell you more about why I've come all this way to visit -
- but it's been a few days since I had a proper meal!
Might you be able to provide me with something nice to eat? I can pay you well for the meal.
I'll see what food I can find...
Sorry, I can't help right now.
villager.dialogue.advisor.quest.join.com: Raw beetroot certainly leaves something to be desired.
Another roadside inn, another meal that makes me miss plain dirt.
Villager's food tests the very definition of 'edible'.
I've traveled these lands far and wide. I now know that every suspicious stew tastes the same.
To serve the meal, right click this villager with a food item.
Thank you so much! That was most delicious.
As promised - here are a few coins to cover the cost!
